0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers, 3-6 and 10th in the East, host the Denver Nuggets, 4-3 and 9th in the West, in the NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site in Mexico City. The Pacers are on a one-game win streak after going 3-2 on the road and 0-4 at home, while Denver is also on a one-game win streak, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In the 2025-26 season series, Indiana lost 0-2, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Kelly Oubre Jr. is day-to-day with a calf bruise and a game-time decision, while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and DeMar DeRozan is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision.
